title: NEON mosquitoes from CO2 light traps, RELEASE-2026: identified mosquitoes of 77 taxa per trap collection at 518 plots across 47 NEON sites, 2014-2024
creator: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network)
citation: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network). Mosquitoes sampled from CO2 traps (DP1.10043.001), RELEASE-2026. https://doi.org/10.48443/rmw1-me46. Dataset accessed from https://data.neonscience.org/data-products/DP1.10043.001/RELEASE-2026 on 2026-11-05
abstract: NEON's mosquito survey: CO2-baited light traps at about ten plots per terrestrial site, set every two weeks through the season (every four weeks off season at some sites), overnight and, until 2017, also by day. A taxonomist identifies a subsample of each catch (by wet weight; obs_proportion_identified gives its share) to species where possible. This table is the number of identified mosquitoes of each taxon per trap collection, all sexes pooled, for the 77 taxa with at least 1000 identified individuals in the release; every shipped taxon has a row at every collection, and a trap with no mosquitoes is y = 0. y counts the identified subsample, not the whole catch. Plot-centre coordinates are as NEON publishes them.
samplingProtocol: CDC-style CO2 light trap (dry ice, or a CO2 canister from 2022-2024) hung about 1.5 m high at a plot, set at dusk and collected after about 12 hours (night) or set in the morning and collected at dusk (day); catch frozen, sorted, and a subsample identified and counted by sex by a taxonomist (NEON TOS mosquito sampling protocol)
surveyEvidenceNote: mos_trapping lists every trap collection (with samplingImpractical where a plot was not trapped); a survey is a row with samplingImpractical OK or blank, targetTaxaPresent Y or N and trapHours > 0. N keeps no sample and is y = 0 for every taxon; a Y sample's counts are its taxonomist rows (a subsample with no mosquitoes is y = 0). Taxon pool national.
closureNote: occasion = trap collection within the plot-year (bouts every two to four weeks through the season, each one to three collections), ordered by set time; period = calendar year
geographicCoverage: 47 NEON terrestrial sites, continental USA, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico; plot-centre coordinates as published by NEON (WGS 84) in __units; latitude 18.0 to 71.3, longitude -156.6 to -66.8

coordinatesCoarsened.method: As published by NEON (agency-published plot-centre coordinates with coordinateUncertaintyInMeters); no coarsening; 3 plots were re-surveyed by a few metres and __units carries the latest

covariateNote: obs_trap_hours = hours between set and collection (effort); obs_proportion_identified = share of the catch (by wet weight) the taxonomist identified, NA where the trap held no mosquitoes (subsampleColumn); obs_night_or_day, obs_trap_type (dry ice / CO2 canister, blank before NEON recorded it), obs_fan_status, obs_co2_status, obs_cup_status and obs_sample_timing as published.
notes: y = identified individuals in the subsample, all sexes pooled (taxon is never species x sex, E6); the whole-catch estimate y / obs_proportion_identified is not shipped. Taxa: the 77 taxa (species with subspecies rolled up, and records identified only to genus or family, E6) with >= 1000 identified individuals; 57 below the cut are listed in notShipped. Surveys dropped: 1665 targetTaxaPresent U, 1 trapHours = 0, 592 samples marked damaged / handling error / incomplete, 209 Y collections with no sorting record, 9 sorted samples with no taxonomist rows, 12 repeat records of one set, 8 targetTaxaPresent N records that nevertheless kept a sample, 24 collections whose taxonomist rows give two different counts for one taxon x sex; 3 exact duplicate taxonomist rows counted once.
